text: Hedera is governed by Hedera Council: only Council members run network nodes, approve updates of the network's technology and have voting rights. McLaren Racing joined Hedera Council, the governing body of Hedera, in March 2026.
short: Hedera is governed by a council of member organisations, which McLaren Racing joined in 2026.
